intro: The time zone, regional format, home location, display language and keyboard layout, plus the formats Windows uses for dates, numbers and currency, all on one page.
Most dropdowns here are filled by Windows itself, so their lists differ from one PC to another. Their tables name the values Winhance writes rather than every choice.

groups.Time: The time zone this PC keeps its clock in. The change takes effect as soon as you apply it.
groups.Region: The regional format Windows starts from, and the country or region apps use for local content. The format here sets the defaults that the Formats group overrides one at a time.
groups.Language and keyboard: The language Windows shows menus, dialogs and Settings in, the keyboard layout it starts with, and the code page for programs that are not Unicode aware. The language and layout apply at your next sign-in, the code page after a restart.
groups.Formats: Individual overrides for parts of the regional format: the short date, the first day of the week, the decimal separators for numbers and currency, the list separator, and metric or U.S. measurements.
